items.prompt: Why is a Monte Carlo average unnecessary for expected_sum(n) on n=1..60?

options.text: More simulations eventually guarantee the exact reduced fraction in finite time.
options.why: Finite random sampling is not a deterministic exact-rational algorithm.

options.text: Linearity gives 7n/2 directly, with exact integer formatting.
options.why: A fixed number of small integer operations computes the required output without sampling error.

options.text: A fixed seed makes every sample average equal the theoretical expectation.
options.why: A seed gives replay, not exact equality between one empirical average and the model expectation.

options.text: The function must enumerate all 6^n face tuples.
options.why: The derivation avoids enumeration as well as simulation.

items.explanation: A fixed number of small integer operations computes the required output without sampling error.
